description: Light a shot (shot_id, or scene + shot; left out: the shot on screen): a lighting preset (the style's moods), and/or the ambient colour and level, and single lights. Any hand change makes it a custom look. Ids must come from the current style: call library to see them (a wrong id is refused with the valid list). Returns the lighting. One undo step for the person. To change the light over time, use set_keyframes (scene:light or light:<id>).

scene.description: Scene index from 0 (with shot). Used when shot_id isn't given.

shot.description: Shot index from 0 inside that scene (with scene; alone: in the scene on screen). A shot id works here too.

shot_id.description: The shot's id from get_project. Or give scene and shot instead. Left out: the shot on screen.

name: set_light
